The EBRD-led equity round (Jun 2026) was also undisclosed. amount_raised is the company's 'more than $120M' equity figure. It has made 18 acquisitions.

wise.com (Wise plc, formerly TransferWise), London; founded 2011 by Taavet Hinrikus and Kristo Käärmann; Seedcamp was a pre-seed/seed investor (sold its stake by 2017). Sourced rounds: $6M Series A 2013 (Valar), $25M Series B 2014 (Branson), $58M Series C 2015 (a16z), $280M Series E Nov 2017 (Old Mutual GI + IVP, ~$1.6B valuation, partly secondary). TechCrunch: total raised $397M as of Nov 2017 (includes a 2016 Series D not itemized here, and some secondary). Later 2019/2020 rounds were largely secondary share sales and not counted. PUBLIC: direct listing on the London Stock Exchange 7 Jul 2021, ~£8.75B (~$11B) valuation (Reuters/CNBC).
